entries.title: Candidate-mechanism plausibility can outrun denominator-scale association evidence
positive_controls_needed: First positive-control pass is present, but second-pass review must decide whether APOE, HLA-B*5701/abacavir, and ADH1B/ALDH2 are comparable controls or belong in distinct subfamilies.
negative_controls_needed: Add at least one negative/control contrast where candidate plausibility and a tight phenotype did not survive denominator-scale testing.
Add at least one case where a narrow-denominator genetic finding transferred robustly across populations after careful testing.
Add at least one therapy-target genetic positive that later failed clinical translation, if source-acquired.
counterexamples_to_seek: Cases where small, mechanistically chosen candidate variants were robust before high-throughput genomics under comparable common-trait conditions.
Cases where GWAS denominator expansion missed a biologically central locus later found by another method.
Cases where a strong pharmacogenomic or enzyme-pathway relation misled practice due to poor actionability or population transfer.
Cases where denominator diversity was limited but the association or clinical actionability was robust across later external validation.
Cases where diversity expansion alone did not repair portability because measurement or environment dominated.
rollback_triggers: The pattern becomes indistinguishable from generic low-power/publication-bias patterns and should be merged into MKH-PAT-0009 or a broader denominator pattern.
Positive controls show that the real axis is phenotype tightness/effect size/actionability, not candidate plausibility vs denominator scale.
Ancestry/phenotype caveats dominate enough that the pattern must split into subpatterns.

maturity_gate.minimum_before_mature: Positive controls, negative controls, ancestry/phenotype caveat records, a split/merge memo, and second-pass source review of every direct supporting claim.

entries.title: Evidence scope follows denominator diversity, portability, and governance

negative_controls_needed: A case where European-ancestry-heavy discovery nevertheless transferred robustly across groups after careful testing.

counterexamples_to_seek: A strong monogenic or pharmacogenomic relation whose evidence is robust despite narrow initial denominator.

rollback_triggers: Evidence shows the pattern is just a restatement of general external-validity limits and should merge into a broader portability pattern.
The ancestry framing becomes too genomics-specific and should be split from governance/capacity infrastructure.
Dynamic-monitor sources prove too unstable for any quantitative snapshot claims without methods/source-code audit.

maturity_gate.minimum_before_mature: At least three genomics cases, two non-genomics analogues, one negative control, one positive intervention/control case, and a methods/source-code audit for dynamic monitor sources.
